title: "00_GAM_survey_data"

Run order: this script (samples and GAM site registry) ->
`python/environmental_timeseries_pull/update_env_cache.py` with both registries (pulls climate
data for any cell-dates not yet cached) -> `01_GAM_model_data.Rmd` (climate and KG joins, model data).

Dataset cleaning follows `size_bd_unified/00_survey_data.Rmd` (same sources, sample selection,
populations and Bd load units), with GAM-specific differences: metamorphs are kept, life stages
use bounded SVL ranges per species, and only the GAM species are selected.

# RACA
```{r}
raca_clean = read.csv(here("data", "JPSL_RACA_Swabbed_Individuals_2026-03-03.csv")) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  filter(life_stage %in% c("A", "S", "Y", "M")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(site = site_name,
         body_mass_g = weight_g,
         site_utme = utme_site,
         site_utmn = utmn_site,
         bd_its_copies = bd_swab_results_its) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date),
         life_stage_simple = case_when(
           life_stage == "M" ~ "metamorph",
           svl_mm >= 50 ~ "adult",
           svl_mm < 50 ~ "subadult"),
         # metamorphs without SVL: typical SVL at metamorphosis
         svl_mm = if_else(life_stage_simple == "metamorph" & is.na(svl_mm), 25, svl_mm),
         site = tolower(gsub(" ", "_", site)),
         region = "W",
         country = "usa",
         project = "RACA",
         taxon_capture = "rana_cascadae",
         sample_id = paste0(bd_swab_id, "_", svl_mm)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(bd_its_copies)) %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()

raca_sites = raca_clean %>%
  select(site,
         site_utme,
         site_utmn) %>%
  distinct()

# convert to lat lon
raca_points = cbind(raca_sites$site_utme,
                    raca_sites$site_utmn)

v_utm = vect(raca_points, crs="+proj=utm +zone=10 +datum=WGS84  +units=m")
v_ll = project(v_utm, "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84")
v_lonlat = geom(v_ll)[, c("x", "y")]

raca_sites_ll = raca_sites %>%
  bind_cols(v_lonlat) %>%
  dplyr::rename(site_longitude = x,
         site_latitude = y) %>%
  select(site,
         site_latitude,
         site_longitude)

raca_valid = raca_clean %>%
  left_join(raca_sites_ll, by = "site") %>%
  select(sample_id,
         taxon_capture,
         date,
         site,
         bd_its_copies,
         life_stage_simple,
         life_stage,
         sex,
         svl_mm,
         body_mass_g,
         site_latitude,
         site_longitude,
         region,
         country,
         project)
```

# USGS
```{r}

## laod USGS data
usgs_raw = read.csv(here("data", "USGSBsalBdDataFull.csv"))

usgs_clean = usgs_raw %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  dplyr::rename(site_latitude = latitude,
         site_longitude = longitude,
         svl_mm = body_length,
         life_stage = age,
         region = reg,
         bd_its_copies = copy_num,
         sample_id = swab_id) %>%
  mutate(taxon_capture = tolower(gsub(" ", "_", scientific_name)),
         life_stage_simple = tolower(life_stage),
         life_stage_simple = recode_values(life_stage_simple,
                                        "juvenile" ~ "subadult",
                                        default = life_stage_simple),
         date = mdy(collection_date),
         site = paste0("usgs_", site_id),
         project = "usgs",
         country = "usa",
         sample_id = paste0(date, "_", sample_id)) %>%
  filter(taxon_capture == "notophthalmus_viridescens",
         !is.na(bd_its_copies),
         !is.na(svl_mm),
         life_stage_simple %in% c("subadult", "adult"),
         svl_mm <= 200) %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()

usgs_valid = usgs_clean %>%
  select(sample_id,
         taxon_capture,
         svl_mm,
         sex,
         life_stage_simple,
         life_stage,
         date,
         bd_its_copies,
         site,
         site_latitude,
         site_longitude,
         region,
         country,
         project)

usgs_spp = usgs_valid %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture,
           life_stage_simple) %>%
  count()
```


# RIBBiTR
```{r}
# same query as size_bd_unified/00_survey_data.Rmd
region_valid_pa = c("altos_de_campana",
                    "caribbean",
                    "el_cope",
                    "el_valle",
                    "santa_fe")

## Connect to DB
dbcon = hopToDB("railway", hopReg = FALSE)

# table pointers
db_bd = tbl(dbcon, Id("survey_data", "bd_qpcr_results"))
db_sample = tbl(dbcon, Id("survey_data", "sample"))
db_capture = tbl(dbcon, Id("survey_data", "capture"))
db_survey = tbl(dbcon, Id("survey_data", "survey"))
db_visit = tbl(dbcon, Id("survey_data", "visit"))
db_project = tbl(dbcon, Id("survey_data", "project"))
db_site = tbl(dbcon, Id("survey_data", "site"))
db_region = tbl(dbcon, Id("survey_data", "region"))
db_country = tbl(dbcon, Id("survey_data", "country"))

# preliminary data
bd_sample = db_sample %>%
  right_join(db_capture, by = "capture_id") %>%
  left_join(db_survey, by = "survey_id") %>%
  left_join(db_visit, by = "visit_id") %>%
  left_join(db_site, by = "site_id") %>%
  left_join(db_region, by = "region_id") %>%
  left_join(db_country, by = "country_id") %>%
  left_join(db_project, by = "project_id") %>%
  filter(sample_type == "bd",
         !is.na(taxon_capture),
         country != "panama" | (country == "panama" & region %in% region_valid_pa),
         !is.na(site_latitude)) %>%
  inner_join(db_bd %>%
              filter(!is.na(bd_detected)) %>%
               # limit to one qPCR result per sample
              group_by(sample_id) %>%
              slice_sample(n = 1, seed = 42) %>%
              ungroup() %>%
              select(sample_id,
                     bd_detected,
                     bd_its1_copies_per_swab), by = "sample_id")

# define life stage simple (GAM: metamorphs kept; SVL bounds drop implausible sizes)
bd_life_stage_ranarasi = bd_sample %>%
  filter(taxon_capture %in% c("rana_muscosa",
                              "rana_sierrae"),
         life_stage %in% c("adult",
                           "subadult",
                           NA) |
           tad_stage >= 44) %>%
  mutate(svl_mm = if_else(!is.na(tad_stage) & is.na(svl_mm), 25, svl_mm),
         life_stage_simple = case_when(
           !is.na(tad_stage) | ((svl_mm >= 20) & svl_mm < 30) ~ "metamorph",
           (svl_mm >= 40) ~ "adult",
           (svl_mm >= 20) & (svl_mm < 40) ~ "subadult",
           .default = NA),
         svl_mm = if_else(life_stage_simple == "metamorph" & is.na(svl_mm), 25, svl_mm))

bd_life_stage_panama = bd_sample %>%
  filter(taxon_capture %in% c("colostethus_panamansis",
                              "lithobates_warszewitschii",
                              "silverstoneia_flotator"),
         life_stage != "larva") %>%
  mutate(life_stage_simple = case_when(
    life_stage == "metamorphosed" ~ "metamorph",
    ((taxon_capture == "colostethus_panamansis") & (svl_mm >= 18.8) & (svl_mm < 50)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "colostethus_panamansis") & (svl_mm >= 10) & (svl_mm < 18.8)) ~ "subadult",
    ((taxon_capture == "lithobates_warszewitschii") & (svl_mm >= 35) & (svl_mm < 100)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "lithobates_warszewitschii") & (svl_mm >= 10) & (svl_mm < 35)) ~ "subadult",
    ((taxon_capture == "silverstoneia_flotator") & (svl_mm >= 15.1) & (svl_mm < 25)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "silverstoneia_flotator") & (svl_mm >= 8) & (svl_mm < 15.1)) ~ "subadult",
    .default = NA),
    svl_mm = case_when(
      taxon_capture == "colostethus_panamansis" & life_stage_simple == "metamorph" & is.na(svl_mm) ~ 12,
      taxon_capture == "lithobates_warszewitschii" & life_stage_simple == "metamorph" & is.na(svl_mm) ~ 20,
      taxon_capture == "silverstoneia_flotator" & life_stage_simple == "metamorph" & is.na(svl_mm) ~ 10,
      .default = svl_mm))

bd_life_stage_nae = bd_sample %>%
  filter(taxon_capture %in% c("rana_catesbeiana",
                              "rana_pipiens",
                              "rana_clamitans",
                              "pseudacris_crucifer",
                              "lithobates_chiricahuensis",
                              "lithobates_sphenocephalus"),
         !(life_stage %in% c("larva"))) %>%
  mutate(life_stage_simple = case_when(
    life_stage == "metamorph" ~ "metamorph",
    ((taxon_capture == "pseudacris_crucifer") & (svl_mm >= 20) & (svl_mm < 40)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "pseudacris_crucifer") & (svl_mm >= 5) & (svl_mm < 20)) ~ "subadult",
    ((taxon_capture == "rana_catesbeiana") & (svl_mm >= 95) & (svl_mm < 200)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "rana_catesbeiana") & (svl_mm >= 10) & (svl_mm < 95)) ~ "subadult",
    ((taxon_capture == "rana_clamitans") & (svl_mm >= 60) & (svl_mm < 110)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "rana_clamitans") & (svl_mm >= 10) & (svl_mm < 60)) ~ "subadult",
    ((taxon_capture == "rana_pipiens") & (svl_mm >= 51) & (svl_mm < 100)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "rana_pipiens") & (svl_mm >= 10) & (svl_mm < 51)) ~ "subadult",
    ((taxon_capture == "lithobates_chiricahuensis") & (svl_mm >= 57) & (svl_mm < 100)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "lithobates_chiricahuensis") & (svl_mm >= 10) & (svl_mm < 57)) ~ "subadult",
    ((taxon_capture == "lithobates_sphenocephalus") & (svl_mm >= 51) & (svl_mm < 100)) ~ "adult",
    ((taxon_capture == "lithobates_sphenocephalus") & (svl_mm >= 10) & (svl_mm < 51)) ~ "subadult",
    .default = NA),
    svl_mm = case_when(
      taxon_capture == "pseudacris_crucifer" & life_stage_simple == "metamorph" & is.na(svl_mm) ~ 13,
      taxon_capture == "rana_catesbeiana" & life_stage_simple == "metamorph" & is.na(svl_mm) ~ 30,
      taxon_capture == "rana_clamitans" & life_stage_simple == "metamorph" & is.na(svl_mm) ~ 28,
      taxon_capture == "rana_pipiens" & life_stage_simple == "metamorph" & is.na(svl_mm) ~ 25,
      taxon_capture == "lithobates_chiricahuensis" & life_stage_simple == "metamorph" & is.na(svl_mm) ~ 40,
      taxon_capture == "lithobates_sphenocephalus" & life_stage_simple == "metamorph" & is.na(svl_mm) ~ 29,
      .default = svl_mm))

ribbitr_cols = c("bd_its1_copies_per_swab",
                 "sample_name",
                 "capture_id",
                 "taxon_capture",
                 "life_stage",
                 "life_stage_simple",
                 "svl_mm",
                 "body_mass_g",
                 "sex",
                 "date",
                 "site",
                 "site_latitude",
                 "site_longitude",
                 "region",
                 "country",
                 "project_id")

ribbitr_valid = union_all(bd_life_stage_ranarasi %>% select(all_of(ribbitr_cols)),
                          bd_life_stage_panama %>% select(all_of(ribbitr_cols))) %>%
  union_all(bd_life_stage_nae %>% select(all_of(ribbitr_cols))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(life_stage_simple),
         !is.na(svl_mm)) %>%
  # limit to 1 bd sample per capture
  group_by(capture_id) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 1, seed = 97) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  collect() %>%
  dplyr::rename(bd_its_copies = bd_its1_copies_per_swab,
                sample_id = sample_name,
                project = project_id) %>%
  select(-capture_id)

```


# Combine data
```{r}
## populations: same definition as the unified pipeline (cluster from the population file,
## else the site)
pops_in = read.csv(here("data", "size_load_pop_1_2026-09-11.csv"))

all_populations = pops_in %>%
  select(site, pop_id) %>%
  dplyr::rename(population = pop_id) %>%
  mutate(population = if_else(!is.na(population), paste0(as.character(population), "_pop"), site),
         site = as.character(site)) %>%
  select(site,
         population)

col_compare = compare_df_cols(ribbitr_valid,
                              raca_valid,
                              usgs_valid)

bd_gam = bind_rows(ribbitr_valid,
                   raca_valid,
                   usgs_valid) %>%
  left_join(all_populations, by = "site") %>%
  # sites missing from the population file (added after it was made) are their own
  # population, as for unclustered sites in the file. listed below (sites_without_population)
  mutate(population_from_file = !is.na(population),
         population = coalesce(population, site)) %>%
  # Bd load cutoff (ITS1 copies per swab): the GAMs use the main cutoff (co100) only,
  # see size_bd_unified/00_survey_data.Rmd
  mutate(year = year(date),
         # harmonise sex labels across sources (F/Female/f, M/Male/m; U/Unknown/not determined/NA)
         sex = case_when(tolower(sex) %in% c("f", "female") ~ "female",
                         tolower(sex) %in% c("m", "male") ~ "male",
                         .default = "unknown"),
         bd_load_co100 = if_else(bd_its_copies < 100,
                                 0,
                                 bd_its_copies),
         bd_detected_co100 = bd_load_co100 > 0,
         bd_load_co100_density = bd_load_co100 / svl_mm)

# drop species with no Bd detections (as in the unified pipeline)
taxa_no_detections = bd_gam %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture) %>%
  summarise(n_pos = sum(bd_detected_co100), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_pos == 0) %>%
  pull(taxon_capture)

taxa_no_detections

bd_gam = bd_gam %>%
  filter(!taxon_capture %in% taxa_no_detections)

(sites_without_population = bd_gam %>%
  filter(!population_from_file) %>%
  count(taxon_capture, project, site, name = "n_samples"))

bd_gam = bd_gam %>%
  select(-population_from_file)

# checks
sum(is.na(bd_gam$bd_its_copies))
sum(is.na(bd_gam$taxon_capture))
sum(is.na(bd_gam$population))

(bd_gam_stats = bd_gam %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture, country) %>%
  summarise(population_n = n_distinct(population),
            site_n = n_distinct(site),
            year_first = year(min(date)),
            year_last = year(max(date)),
            metamorph_n = sum(life_stage_simple == "metamorph"),
            subadult_n = sum(life_stage_simple == "subadult"),
            adult_n = sum(life_stage_simple == "adult"),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(country,
          taxon_capture))

# clean up rounding error lat/lons
distinct_sites_clean = bd_gam %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(site_latitude = mean(site_latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
            site_longitude = mean(site_longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

bd_gam_clean = bd_gam %>%
  select(-site_latitude,
         -site_longitude) %>%
  left_join(distinct_sites_clean, by = "site")

peace = get_dupes(bd_gam_clean, sample_id)
(peace)

```

# Site registry
```{r}
# one row per site, as in size_bd_unified/00_survey_data.Rmd. pull climate for both pipelines with
#   python update_env_cache.py --registry ../../size_bd_unified/intermediates/site_registry.csv \
#                                         ../../size_bd_gam/intermediates/site_registry_gam.csv
site_registry_gam = bd_gam_clean %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(latitude = dplyr::first(site_latitude),
            longitude = dplyr::first(site_longitude),
            date_min = min(date),
            date_max = max(date),
            n_samples = n(),
            .groups = "drop")

if (anyNA(site_registry_gam)) {
  print(filter(site_registry_gam, if_any(everything(), is.na)))
  stop("sites with missing coordinates or dates")
}

write_csv(site_registry_gam, here("size_bd_gam", "intermediates", "site_registry_gam.csv"))
saveRDS(bd_gam_clean, here("size_bd_gam", "intermediates", "bd_survey_gam_clean.rds"))

```
